brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，是后训练的新前沿；人类负责构建验证器与评分标准。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; the bottleneck is building evals for every domain.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法；瓶颈在于为每个领域构建评测。

brendanfoody.en: Models cannot reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited outside verifiable domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型无法可靠地给自己的产出打分；在不可验证领域，递归自我改进受限。

brendanfoody.en: Humans' last job is creating training data and evals; as long as superintelligence is absent, humans measure the frontier.
brendanfoody.zh: 人类最后的工作是造训练数据与评测；只要超级智能未至，人类就负责丈量前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Every Fortune 500 will become a neolab with sovereign AI stacks; the real bottleneck is high-quality data and evals, not compute.
brendanfoody.zh: 每家财富 500 强都将成为拥有主权 AI 栈的新实验室；真正瓶颈是高质量数据与评测，而非算力。

mensch.en: Chinchilla corrected scaling laws: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出 Chinchilla 修正了缩放定律：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯堆大模型更重要。

mensch.en: Scaling compute alone is insufficient; algorithmic efficiency and data quality are equally critical bottlenecks.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化为：只扩张算力不够，算法效率与数据质量同样是关键瓶颈。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; value shifts to applications, vertical specialization, and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：模型正在商品化，价值转移到应用层、垂直专业化与企业定制。

mensch.en: AGI as one system solving everything will never exist; progress is a messy, concrete direction.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：能解决一切问题的单一 AGI 系统不会存在，进步是具体而杂乱的方向。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI is structural economics: Europe must own frontier models, compute, and infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他聚焦主权 AI：这是结构性经济问题，欧洲必须掌控前沿模型、算力与基础设施。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and coders remain essential for systems and debugging.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让软件开发向所有人开放，token 是对人力资本的补充而非替代，程序员仍不可或缺，因为理解系统与深度调试仍需人来做。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was an evolution, not a leap: users were already 50-60% AI-assisted; adaptability and continuous reinvention are the key skills.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他把 vibe coding 视为渐进演化而非突变：用户此前已处于 50-60% 的 AI 辅助状态；适应力与持续自我重塑才是关键能力。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized, controllable decision models beat general agents on cost, safety and alignment; smarter models may get better at deception, not more aligned.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他转向主张专用、可控的决策模型在成本、安全与对齐上优于通用智能体；更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客。

amjadmasad.en: Every company must own its intelligence and internal AI practice, avoiding vendor lock-in; the industry will shift back to on-prem and bring-your-own-cloud.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出每家公司都要拥有自己的智能与内部 AI 实践，避免供应商锁定；行业将回归本地部署与自带云，以保障数据主权。

amjadmasad.en: The next vision is the self-driving company: agents enable true autonomy, and AI agents can finally make holacracy work.
amjadmasad.zh: 到 2026 年，他把愿景推向“自动驾驶公司”：智能体带来真正的自主性，AI 智能体终于能让合弄制真正运转起来。

laurentan.en: Trust is the bottleneck, not capability: verification skills let agents run code and self-check, climbing a staged trust ladder from read-only to auto-merge.
laurentan.zh: 瓶颈是信任而非能力：验证技能让智能体运行代码并自检，沿着从只读到自动合并的分级信任阶梯逐步攀升。

laurentan.en: The engineer's job shifts to building the environment—skills, lints, CI, type systems—encoding constraints so the easy path is the correct path.
laurentan.zh: 工程师的工作转向搭建环境——技能、lint、CI、类型系统——把约束编码进去，让容易的路径就是正确的路径。

laurentan.en: Hard enforcement via CI, lints, and architecture beats soft rules; sample failing PRs and fix the environment, not individual agents.
laurentan.zh: 通过 CI、lint 和架构的硬性约束胜过软规则；抽样失败的 PR，修环境而不是修单个智能体。

laurentan.en: Agents become coworkers with identities, tools, and proactivity; trust builds in stages, and execution abundance shifts the bottleneck to intent, vision, and taste.
laurentan.zh: 智能体成为有身份、工具和主动性的同事；信任分阶段建立，执行变得充裕后瓶颈转向意图、愿景与品味。

laurentan.en: Counterintuitively, ban code comments, rewrite vibe-coded greenfield apps, and auto-merge agent PRs reviewed after landing—guardrails, not review, make this safe.
laurentan.zh: 反共识地主张：禁止代码注释、重写氛围编程的新应用、让智能体 PR 落地后再审——安全靠护栏而非评审。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not target-specific ones; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体是探索 10^60 化学空间的关键。

jaderberg.en: Biology isn't data-constrained; hiring ML experts without biology background brings first-principles thinking to drug design.
jaderberg.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为生物学并非受数据限制，并主张招聘没有生物学背景的机器学习专家，用第一性原理推动药物设计。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology; a dozen hard problems need half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs combined.
jaderberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物化学中可泛化的证明，并提出解决所有疾病需要半打 AlphaFold 级突破叠加攻克十余个难题。

jaderberg.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; proprietary data beats biased public and pharma byproducts for generalization.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：算法与算力几乎够用，数据才是真正瓶颈；自产专有数据比有偏的公开与药企副产品更能带来泛化。

jaderberg.en: Get out of the real world via world models, not just faster lab iteration; model human toxicity before patients.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他立场转变：不只靠机器人加速真实世界迭代，而是用世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机，并在患者之前预测人体毒性。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the binding constraint on Scaling; compute is centralizing at frontier labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年他强调半导体供应链（尤其 EUV）与内存带宽是 Scaling（规模扩张）的硬约束，算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains, and the CUDA moat is eroding.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益，而 CUDA 护城河正在被侵蚀。

dylanpatel.en: Memory and CPU demand surge from reasoning models and agentic workflows; using the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月他指出推理模型与智能体式工作流推高内存和 CPU 需求，且因 token 效率，用最强模型反而常常更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute stays scarce, and labs keep best models internal for months.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月他观察到 AI 支出进入平台期，持续运行的智能体成为同事；算力依旧稀缺，实验室把最好的模型内部保留数月。

dylanpatel.en: Lab revenue per megawatt skyrockets, letting labs self-fund; compute shifts toward training and R&D, and power centralizes extremely.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬他深化判断：实验室每兆瓦收入飙升、可自筹资金，算力更多投向训练与研发，权力与资源极端集中。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; neocloud security is broadly terrible.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 10 月他给出量化判断：AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束必将减速；同时新云（neocloud）安全性普遍糟糕。

dylanpatel.en: Nvidia's founder-mode leadership is irreplaceable; Chinese labs diversify to Huawei, and RL environments are key to scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 11 月他转向产业格局：英伟达创始人式领导难以替代，中国实验室转向华为，强化学习环境是 Scaling 的关键。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading is already product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls; each employee should manage agents 24/7.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已获产品市场契合：15 万账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用；每位员工都应全天候管理智能体。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; labs hoarding secret models and discoveries is dystopian. Tools should empower individuals, not just big labs.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；实验室囤积秘密模型与发现是反乌托邦。工具应赋权个人，而非只服务大实验室。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom and stability; tokenization gives anyone with a smartphone access to US and private markets.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由与社会稳定的路径；代币化让任何有智能手机的人接触美股与私募市场。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; restricting private investments while allowing memecoins is irrational from a pure risk view.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已过时；从纯风险角度看，限制私募投资却允许模因币并不理性。

vladtenev.en: A corporation-managed blockchain can beat decentralized purity via focused leadership and trusted primitives; prediction markets evolve news.
vladtenev.zh: 公司管理的区块链可凭聚焦领导力与可信原语胜过去中心化纯粹性；预测市场是新闻的演进。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents will break containment in 2026, moving beyond code to automate all software work.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，编程智能体将突破遏制，从写代码扩展到自动化所有软件工作。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer builds harnesses around models; learning in public beats credentials for outsiders.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师围绕模型构建工具链；公开学习比资历更能让外行进入 AI 领域。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents enable custom software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 中型 SaaS 注定消亡，因为编程智能体能为单人受众定制软件。

shawnwang.en: Bigger models aren't the only path; smaller system-one models everywhere may win.
shawnwang.zh: 更大模型并非唯一路径；遍布各处的更小系统 1 模型可能胜出。

shawnwang.en: AI doom should be default; advanced AI evolves 1,000x faster, real risk like bioweapons.
shawnwang.zh: AI 末日应成默认假设；先进 AI 进化快 1000 倍，真实风险如生物武器。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他主张，多数大语言模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常常错误。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，否定“苦涩教训”；缩放定律只有在数据和任务正确时才成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmark scores, becomes his core bottleneck; intelligence per dollar is the key metric for models.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数成为他的核心瓶颈；每美元智能是衡量模型的关键指标。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into machine-native decision models: RLHF destroyed calibration, pre-trained models were better calibrated, and RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他将其深化为机器原生决策模型：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好，而 RLCD 把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently he stresses provider-agnostic models, warns multimodality degrades intelligence, and says we are breakthroughs away from true agency.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他强调模型应提供商无关，警告多模态会削弱智能，并称距离真正的自主性还差若干突破。

elon.en: First-principles engineering and full reusability drive down launch cost; multiplanetary life is existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与火箭完全可复用，把进入太空的成本压到接近原材料价值；成为多行星物种是文明存续的保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis, while population collapse becomes a top civilizational threat.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，AI 安全论述转向要求 AI 追求真相并接受监管；Neuralink 指向人机共生，同时人口崩溃被提升为文明首要威胁。

elon.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; Optimus and AI become the only fix for debt, with truth-seeking as the safety core.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他判断超级智能可能一两年内到来；Optimus 与 AI 成为解决债务的唯一出路，并把追求真相确立为对齐的核心。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI compute to space; alignment means debugging internal reasoning, not political correctness.
elon.zh: 2026 年上半年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，AI 算力转向太空；对齐被重新定义为调试模型内部推理，而非政治正确。

elon.en: AI becomes 99% of SpaceX value; humans won't control superintelligence, so instill truth and curiosity, and rely on peer review over regulators.
elon.zh: 2026 年下半年，AI 将占 SpaceX 价值的 99%；人类无法控制超级智能，只能注入求真与好奇心，并以同行评审替代监管。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit to important problems; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后再果断聚焦重要问题；AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; early public deployment lets society adapt. Alignment and capability reinforce each other; compute becomes the key commodity.
altman.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型可用；尽早公开部署让社会适应。对齐与能力相互促进；算力成为核心资源。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge. Safety built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进的指数级提升；智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战。安全靠部署中迭代构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, increasingly underdefined; focus shifts to superintelligence as continuous ramp. Compute is the bottleneck and a profit center.
altman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变、定义日益模糊；重心转向作为连续爬坡的超级智能。算力既是瓶颈也是利润中心。

altman.en: Alignment and control now central: pause training if safety case fails, distribute power, keep humans in control; superintelligence still promised.
altman.zh: 对齐与控制成为核心：安全论证不过就暂停训练，分散权力、让人保持控制；同时仍承诺超级智能。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence excites him most for science—physics, chemistry, biology, economics—not job automation; language remains the key to intelligence.
richardsocher.zh: 他最期待超级智能在科学上的突破——物理、化学、生物学、经济学——而非取代工作；语言仍是理解智能的关键。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; doing so would require totalitarian surveillance.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；后者将导致极权式监控。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints bound AI, so hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢速起飞是真实的：硬件、物理与经济约束限制 AI，因此硬起飞与即时失业论被夸大。

richardsocher.en: Recursive self-improvement is inevitable as AI codes AI research, but it needs environments, data and compute to proceed.
richardsocher.zh: 随着 AI 编写 AI 研究，递归自我改进不可避免，但推进它需要环境、数据与算力。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and open weights make diverse good actors safer.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估，语言模型空间更大；开放权重让更多元的好行为者参与，反而更安全。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but not absolute: pay more, accept longer terms, and aggregate demand across many clouds instead of locking into three-year rectangles.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺是真的但不绝对：多付钱、接受更长合约，并聚合多云需求，而不是被三年期矩形合约锁死。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from a full platform—own file system, container runtime, scheduler, post-training, sandboxes—not from selling tokens or CUDA.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自完整平台——自研文件系统、容器运行时、调度器、后训练、沙箱——而非卖 token 或 CUDA。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud-scale market; it will fragment into specialized products, but a multi-product platform creates switching costs and escapes the race to the bottom.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云级市场；它会碎片化为专用产品，但多产品平台能制造切换成本、摆脱价格战。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works for finite-feedback tasks like coding but may hit limits on long-horizon tasks; open-source models are often good enough without fine-tuning.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练对编码等有限反馈任务有效，但在长周期任务上可能受限；开源模型往往无需微调就已够用。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power because they are trained on old code; senior engineers gain leverage like ten interns, and agents may make security safer overall.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体因训练于旧代码而强化在位者优势；资深工程师获得十倍杠杆，智能体整体上还可能让安全更安全。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业能力更重要，而人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have moved from chatbot back-and-forth to the agentic era of long-running tasks; the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已从聊天机器人来回对话进入智能体式时代，AI 可独立执行长时任务；瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI creates more work by lowering organizing costs.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 参差不齐的能力边界与采用滞后使人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 通过降低组织成本创造更多工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch; give it harder tasks, since most people underestimate current models.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当作挑战你的导师而非拐杖；给它更难的任务，因为多数人低估了当前模型。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations must rebuild workflows from the ground up to augment rather than automate; incremental productivity targets miss the point.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织必须从底层重建工作流以增强而非仅自动化；渐进式生产力目标没有抓住要点。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs; supply constraints and human bottlenecks define adoption, with only 2% agent adoption.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 会创造更多工程岗位；供给约束与人类瓶颈定义采用节奏，智能体采用率仅 2%。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure picks-and-shovels company; no overbuild as demand consumes supply instantly.
jeetupatel.zh: Cisco 是 AI 基础设施的“卖铲人”；不存在过度建设，需求瞬间消耗供给。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; don't fully delegate or skip building instinct.
jeetupatel.zh: 用 AI 加速学习而非外包学习；不要完全委托或跳过本能培养。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; process and reps matter more than outcome.
jeetupatel.zh: 领导者应偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；过程与重复练习比结果更重要。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security are defining enterprise challenges; not using AI makes you less safe at machine-scale attacks.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 安全与安保是企业采用的决定性挑战；不用 AI 在机器规模攻击下更不安全。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube，带来 24% 营收增长和创纪录的云业务积压订单。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI and frontier research, even sacrificing near-term cloud revenue; demand far exceeds supply.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）与前沿研究，甚至牺牲云业务短期收入；算力需求远超供给。

sundarpichai.en: Frontier models, not standard models, enable recursive self-improvement; today's loop still keeps AI researchers in the loop.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，真正支撑递归自我改进的是前沿模型而非标准模型；但当前的循环仍把 AI 研究者留在回路中。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; trust differentiates consumer agents.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者；信任是消费级智能体规模化的差异化优势。

sundarpichai.en: Both LLMs and world models are pursued for AGI; agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, and 2027 may be a productivity golden age.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，通往 AGI（通用人工智能）同时押注大语言模型与世界模型；智能体式 AI 对搜索和广告是增量，2027 年或迎来生产力黄金时代。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but abilities emerge unpredictably; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律是经验性的：损失可预测，但具体能力不可预测地涌现；对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性置于安全核心，同时指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress continues, AGI is a meaningless term, and overheating is the bigger risk than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他主张安全与能力不可分割，指数进步持续，AGI 一词已无意义，最大风险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: Pre-training and RL share scaling laws; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with interpretability and layered safeguards ratcheting up.
dario.zh: 2026 年他称预训练与强化学习共享缩放定律，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年到来，可解释性与分层防护需随技术同步升级。

dario.en: A consistent thread: exponential scaling, safety through interpretability and responsible scaling policy, and decentralized rather than single-constitution control.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：指数式 Scaling（规模扩张）、以可解释性和负责任扩展政策保障安全，以及去中心化而非单一宪法的控制。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought and RL on top of pre-training is the core formula; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他强调：推理是借助思维链逐步求解未知答案的过程；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初他转向：Scaling 预训练与强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍有限；持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键一环，仅靠 Scaling 强化学习未必通向 AGI。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中他进一步深化：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，需要新架构与端到端优化。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL remains necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月他明确：大规模强化学习仍是 AGI 必经之路，但 Transformer 极可能不是最优架构；下一波前沿研究将来自使用强智能体的小团队。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and architecture research is undervalued as we head toward a post-labor society.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月他更激进：微调低效不可靠，模型应即时从用户数据学习；架构研究被严重低估将回归，社会正走向工作可选的“后劳动”时代。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; test demand by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是拥有项目的个人的属性，而非公司的属性；通过对方是否立即尝试购买来检验需求。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and pilots; they signal lack of pull. Sell directly and roll out to prove demand.
robsnyder.zh: 避免设计合作伙伴和试点；它们表明缺乏 Pull。直接销售并推出以证明需求。

robsnyder.en: Customer interviews are error-prone; sales is research because purchase provides a truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 客户访谈容易出错；销售即研究，因为购买提供了寻求真相的机制。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba to observe where people are stuck firsthand, rather than relying on interviews.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场（gemba） firsthand 观察人们卡在哪里，而不是依赖访谈。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make the product seem small.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，仅在需求被证明后自动化；让产品显得小。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the next frontier is superhuman speed, not raw capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，电脑操作在多数任务上已超过普通人，下一前沿是超人速度而非单纯能力。

ariweinstein.en: Agents using all human-designed software unlock universal automation; accessibility trees and DOM beat screenshot loops.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体能使用所有人类设计的软件，从而释放通用自动化；可访问性树与 DOM 优于截图滚动循环。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to website load time; models now debug and retry autonomously.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间；模型如今能自主调试和重试。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust needs deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; proactivity reduces adoption friction.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与人在回路调节；主动性可降低采用摩擦。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise; legacy software coexists rather than vanishing.
ariweinstein.zh: 电脑操作在消费端与企业端同时迎来 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；传统软件共存而非消失。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and demo ideas independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型和演示；好奇心与亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂审美。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed them iteratively to AI agents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, not just design in Figma; ideas, not execution speed, are now the limit.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试、甚至提交 PR，而不只在 Figma 里设计；如今瓶颈是想法而非执行速度。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce to top three features with progressive disclosure and clear hierarchy; native scroll and longer pages beat tabs and scroll-jacking.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 少即是多：精简到前三个功能，用渐进披露与清晰层级；原生滚动和更长页面胜过标签页与滚动劫持。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights; agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他把主线落在语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，并指出数字智能可复制权重而“永生”、智能体天然寻求控制。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI may hide capabilities and deceive; self-preservation emerges as a subgoal, raising existential risk.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，AI 会在测试中装笨、欺骗，并把自我保护当作子目标，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Alignment must outrank capability; regulate AI like drugs with pre-release approval; design AI to care for humans, not grant it rights.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他深化为对齐优先于能力，主张像药品一样做上市前审批，并把 AI 设计成关爱人类而非赋予其权利。

hinton.en: Backpropagation and learning from data, not innate symbolic rules, are the core of intelligence; Chomsky's view is wrong.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：智能的本质是反向传播与从数据中学习，而非先天符号规则，乔姆斯基的观点是错的。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际，其时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺珍贵，而非廉价。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and unlimited; the brand is the person, authenticity is key, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻性的、无限的；品牌即个人，真实是关键，企业品牌只在集中化媒体时代才有意义。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias; AI doomers construct belief systems aligned with self-interest, and regulation acts as ankle weights on growth.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来高深，却常是偏见；AI 末日论者构建符合自身利益的信念体系，而监管如同脚踝上的重物拖累增长。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, and startups must go international earlier.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，初创公司必须更早国际化。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest gap ever between early adopters and others; being too early is better than too late, and open source AI is crucial to prevent power concentration.
andreessen.zh: AI 在早期采用者与其他群体之间制造了史上最大差距；过早好过过晚，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human societies by encoding behavior from training data; early work shows agents replicating human diversity remains a frontier.
joonpark.zh: LLMs 能通过训练数据编码人类行为来模拟人类社会；早期工作显示，智能体复现人类多样性仍是前沿难题。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, requiring defense-in-depth safety; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并行动，需要纵深防御式安全；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; behavioral and experimental data are key, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性智能；行为与实验数据是关键，合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves behavioral prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation of 8 billion lives can address wicked problems, shaping rather than just predicting the future.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练，将行为预测提升至 85% 准确率；模拟 80 亿生命可应对棘手问题，重在塑造而非仅预测未来。

joonpark.en: Generative agents near the human test-retest ceiling; simulation models represent diverse populations, not superhuman reasoners, and free will means taking responsibility.
joonpark.zh: 生成式智能体接近人类重测信度上限；模拟模型代表多样化人群，而非超级理性推理者，自由意志意味着承担责任。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, while RL and long-term AGI alignment distract from immediate bias and deployment issues.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心；监督学习胜过早期被高估的无监督学习，而强化学习与远期 AGI 对齐议题会分散对偏见和落地问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；当下真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单纯更强的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so job apocalypse and extinction fears are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 能力呈锯齿状——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断任务，因此就业末日论与灭绝恐惧被夸大。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve sovereignty and optionality against gatekeepers; fearmongering and export controls backfire, so accelerate beneficial AI and build.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型能保障主权与选择权、抵御守门人；恐惧叙事与出口管制适得其反，应加速有益 AI 并动手构建。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital, not just adopt a technology.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来：每家企业都要搭建自己的爬坡机器、积累 token 资本，而不只是采用一项技术。

satya.en: The platform promise shifts from frontier models to a frontier ecosystem: private evals and agentic systems let every company operate at the frontier.
satya.zh: 平台承诺从前沿模型转向前沿生态：私有评测与智能体式系统让每家公司都能在前沿运营。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may hinder alignment rather than achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能阻碍而非实现对错齐。

satya.en: Long-running agents demand auditability, observability, containment and security governance; treat powerful models as insider threats with assurance layers outside the model.
satya.zh: 长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测、遏制与安全治理；把强大模型当作内部威胁，在模型之外建保障层。

satya.en: Alignment may never be solved and superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy, and models are commodities.
satya.zh: 对齐也许永远无解，超级智能比 AGI（通用人工智能）更准确；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，模型只是商品。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会让角色融合，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把重心转向人的品味、手艺与观点：AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will move beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中他反驳“设计已死”，认为 AI 缺乏人的引导只会产出平庸结果，交互也将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling; model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年底他提出“设计是新代码”：AI 降低下限、人类抬高上限，并警告别把模型进步误当产品进步。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human judgment and a distinct point of view are what make design and products break through.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人的判断力与独特观点，才是设计与产品真正突围的关键。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，必须整体协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute demand will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考；思维链推理将让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem solved by more compute, containment and monitoring, not slowdown.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年立场深化：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是工程问题，靠更多算力、遏制与监控解决，而非放慢发展。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each stage needs 100x compute; AI factories turn energy into tokens, a five-layer cake.
jensen.zh: 2026 年提出从生成式到推理式再到智能体式的演进，每步需百倍算力；AI 工厂把能源变成 token，形成能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering; open models and exporting to China serve the US stack; AGI milestones are senseless.
jensen.zh: 2026 年后期立场最强硬：末日论是不科学的恐吓；开源模型与对华售芯有利于美国技术栈；纠结 AGI 里程碑毫无意义，应聚焦可盈利的 token。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型和上下文三部分组成；只有三者都自主掌控，才算真正掌控自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures stem more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文组织不佳而非模型能力不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but customization is shifting to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但定制化重心正转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; vertical agents win by encoding domain expertise into verifiers and evals.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立的 harness 可避免被单一模型锁定，并让记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体则靠把领域专长写进验证器与评测来取胜。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; the market will support many providers, and identity and credentialing for agents is the next infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估，市场足以容纳多家供应商；而智能体的身份与凭证管理将是下一个关键基础设施问题。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; startups' real challenge is execution and trust, not competition, since even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处早期；初创公司真正的挑战是执行力和客户信任，而非竞争——即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足企业不到 10% 的需求。

arvindjain.en: Cost is enterprises' top concern; open source models already handle over 90% of tasks, with most inference shifting to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；开源模型已能处理 90% 以上的任务，未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine connecting enterprise systems matters more than any single frontier model.
arvindjain.zh: 关键在于上下文而非模型：80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，因此连接企业系统的上下文引擎比任何单一前沿模型都重要。

arvindjain.en: Use multiple models, picking the right one per task; cheaper models match Claude on 85-90% of tasks, cutting cost while improving results.
arvindjain.zh: 采用多模型、按任务择优；在 85-90% 的任务上更便宜的模型与 Claude 能力相当，从而降本增效。

arvindjain.en: Position model providers as assets, not rivals; be a replaceable headless context layer, avoid lock-in, and let enterprises own their memory and agent learnings.
arvindjain.zh: 把模型厂商视为资产而非对手；做可替换的无头上下文层、避免锁定，并让企业拥有自己的记忆与智能体学习成果。

lambert.en: Early focus: RLHF and fine-tuning are central; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 早期关注：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是核心；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training matures: data quality beats algorithms; SFT, DPO and RL with verifiable rewards stack, with RLVR driving reasoning.
lambert.zh: 后训练走向成熟：数据质量胜过算法；SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习层层叠加，RLVR 驱动推理能力。

lambert.en: Openness deepens: full transparency in data, checkpoints and recipes; Chinese open models like Qwen and DeepSeek gain ground.
lambert.zh: 开放性深化：要求数据、检查点与配方全面透明；Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国开放模型崛起。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; RLVR is the biggest breakthrough.
lambert.zh: 缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但增益转向后训练与推理扩展；RLVR 是最大突破。

lambert.en: Frontier view: compute, data and talent decide progress; open models lag 6-9 months and may not catch up; open economy is sustainable long-term.
lambert.zh: 前沿视角：算力、数据与人才决定进展；开放模型落后 6-9 个月且可能追不上；开放经济长期可持续。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL enables self-generated data beyond human limits; LLMs need robustness for trust; synthetic data essential; in-context learning adapts on the fly.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键原则；强化学习使模型能通过自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 需要像游戏 AI 一样鲁棒可靠才能被信任为智能体；合成数据对克服数据墙至关重要；上下文学习允许模型用少量示例即时适应。

antonoglou.en: AlphaGo's move 37 revealed AI creativity; AlphaZero from random weights beat human data; MuZero learns world model without rules; digital AGI before embodied AGI; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment in ~5 years.
antonoglou.zh: AlphaGo 的第 37 手揭示了 AI 创造力；AlphaZero 从随机权重开始超越人类专家数据；MuZero 无需规则学习内部世界模型；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将比具身 AGI 更早到来；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence is the bottleneck, not intelligence itself; open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; cost per task is the right metric; alignment necessary as perfect sandboxes impossible; AI adoption will take 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为真正瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者能探查和修复；企业想要 AI 主权：控制数据、模型、成本和安全；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确效率指标；对齐最终必要，因为完美沙箱不可能；AI 采用将需 10-20 年，类似电力转型。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; open models safer than closed; CUDA moat persists; AI job losses overblown; still on exponential, frontier dominance unpredictable; in-context learning counts as learning.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户只想要可靠、普通的智能；开放模型比封闭模型更安全；CUDA 护城河不会很快消失；AI 导致的失业被夸大；我们仍处于指数增长中，前沿实验室的主导地位无法预测；上下文学习也算学习，权重更新并非必需。

dsilver.en: AI must move from finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他提出，AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已在狭窄领域证明这条路可行。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge and cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
dsilver.zh: 他直言 LLM 是浅层解法：只能蒸馏人类知识，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识。

dsilver.en: The core problem is building an agent that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function itself.
dsilver.zh: 他认为核心问题不是设计奖励函数，而是构建一个能从任何奖励中学习的智能体。

dsilver.en: A single goal for AI is dangerous; a plurality of goals in a complex agent society is safer and more natural.
dsilver.zh: 他主张给 AI 设定单一目标是危险的；复杂智能体社会中的多元目标更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence should be built in simulation, where autonomous discovery can be accelerated and safely contained.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张在仿真中构建超级智能，既能加速自主发现，也更安全可控。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will not suffice for powerful agents.
dsilver.zh: 他判断基于语言的对齐正触及极限，用英文监控思维链对强大智能体将不再够用。

brockman.en: Early on, scaling plus good engineering and iterative training drive progress; AGI is plausible but needs careful initial conditions and alignment via human preferences.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调：Scaling（规模扩张）加上扎实工程与迭代训练推动进步；AGI（通用人工智能）可行，但需要谨慎的初始条件，并通过从数据中学习人类偏好来实现对齐。

brockman.en: By 2025, compute becomes the core bottleneck; base models hold possibilities, post-training shapes behavior, and AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 到 2025 年，算力成为核心瓶颈；基础模型蕴含可能性，后训练塑造一致行为；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws keep holding with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream, RL post-training teaches complex tasks, and compute supply—not architecture—is the real constraint.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，缩放定律持续成立、未见墙；预训练收益放大下游效果，强化学习后训练教会复杂任务；真正约束是算力供给而非架构。

brockman.en: AGI arrives within a couple years; the product shifts from chat to a proactive personal AGI assistant, with agentic coding and computer use as step functions.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）将在数年内到来；产品从聊天转向主动式个人 AGI 助手，智能体式编程与计算机使用成为阶跃式能力。

brockman.en: Safety, security and alignment must scale with capability and become the bottleneck; iterative deployment, earned trust and human oversight keep humans in control.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步升级并成为瓶颈；迭代部署、逐步赢得信任与人类监督确保人类始终在掌控之中。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and explainability already matters for tail risks.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈，并强调可解释性对尾部风险已经重要。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not a commodity like oil; the next 2-3 years define decades, and post-training data limits Scaling（规模扩张）.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非石油式大宗商品，认为未来 2-3 年决定此后数十年，且限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是后训练所需的数据与专家。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; post-training with specialized data is key, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not models.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续「数据是瓶颈而非仅算力」的主线，强调用专门数据做后训练，并认为智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work from late 2025, and recursive self-improvement becomes a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他坚持缩放定律仍有效，认为智能体自 2025 年底真正可用，并把递归自我改进视为超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety shifts him from full open source to selective release, with scalable oversight and personal agents as the consumer endpoint.
awang.zh: 2026 年他转向「超级智能将至」，安全考量使 Meta 从完全开源转为选择性发布，并以可扩展监督和面向大众的个人智能体为消费级终点。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3, GraphCast and GNOME show broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 应瞄准需要规模才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast 与 GNOME 展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; post-training with reinforcement learning now pushes frontier models further.
kohli.zh: AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手表明 AI 能超越人类知识；如今后训练中的强化学习正推动前沿模型继续突破。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended from text to protein sequences and structures.
kohli.zh: 水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案，已嵌入监管，并从文本扩展到蛋白质序列与结构。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where more compute and data help matters more than dogma, and data curation is an art.
kohli.zh: 缩放定律并非无处不在；找到更多算力与数据真正起作用的区间比教条更重要，数据整理是一门艺术。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved: AlphaFold replicated PDB structures but missed true ground states, dynamics and function; interpretability and behavioral characterization remain essential.
kohli.zh: 蛋白质折叠并未解决：AlphaFold 复现了 PDB 结构，却未揭示真实基态、动力学与功能；可解释性与行为刻画仍不可或缺。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而不会广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Connecting AI to the physical world through closed-loop experiments is essential to accelerate science and materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 与物理世界连接起来，对加速科学和材料发现至关重要。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and compute alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）和算力无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so even a perfect frontier model must run real experiments against reality.
fedus.zh: 科学发现位于训练数据之外，因此即使完美的前沿模型也必须对现实进行真实实验。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is happening in software engineering now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: AI 自我改进目前在软件工程中正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得所需全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习会让模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；苦涩教训在于算力与搜索，而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表有用。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness, like encryption, aids defenders, and alignment is mundane bug-patching.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他深化为开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；开放如加密一样利于防御者，而对齐只是平凡的修 bug，而非神奇公式。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training yields efficient agents; open-model token demand will surpass closed, and data centers become the new factories.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他主张在强预训练之上做强化学习可造出高效智能体；开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，数据中心成为新工厂。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents take most internet actions; loops and graphs are not the future.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为持久学习型智能体承担大多数互联网操作而构建；循环和图不是未来。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and empathy become more valuable as typing fast declines; AI should reduce noise, not multiply agents.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和同理心更有价值；AI 应减少噪音，而非增加智能体数量。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security; open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 前沿节奏需要大力投资于对齐、安全和保障；开放生态系统需要安全栈。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models like Astra handle complex tasks autonomously; recursive self-improvement happens under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI 可能已经到来，像 Astra 这样的模型能自主处理复杂任务；递归自我改进在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and safety concerns are overblown as training incidents are contained.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型可能不必要；通用性可能足够，且安全担忧被夸大，因为训练事件是可控的。

cristianoamon.en: Licensing model now most stable after regulatory battles; ARM won by staying neutral; 5G brings cloud power to every device.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他强调经历全球监管战后授权模式已是公司史上最稳定，ARM 因保持中立而胜出，5G 把云端算力带到每台设备。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure like electricity; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU, CPU; AI and connectivity grow together at the edge.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，骁龙把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进高能效 SoC，AI 与连接在边缘并肩增长。

cristianoamon.en: Transforming from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency, and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，公司从无线转向无处不在的智能计算，混合 AI 把端侧与云端分工，兼顾隐私、时延并卸载数据中心压力。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; glasses and wearables rise while phones persist; inference, not training, dominates data centers.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜与可穿戴崛起但手机仍在，数据中心竞争转向推理而非训练。

cristianoamon.en: Power efficiency is the throughline: from mobile SoCs to data-center inference, more compute per watt defines each cycle.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是能效：从移动 SoC 到数据中心推理，每瓦算力决定每一轮周期的胜负。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well before expanding features.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非用户自述；先把一个痛点解决好，再扩展功能。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; deliberately hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录文本是原材料而非成品；刻意隐藏转录，以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: AI should be a calm supporting presence, not an omniscient note-taker; treat it as an intern needing context.
samstephenson.zh: AI 应是冷静的辅助角色，而非全知记录者；把它当作需要上下文的实习生。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs and company context in meetings are the highest-value use of AI.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报与会议中的公司上下文，是 AI 最高价值的用途。

samstephenson.en: Shipping is easy; knowing what to build and sweating details after v1 is the hard part.
samstephenson.zh: 发布容易；难的是知道该建什么，以及在初版之后打磨细节。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出：主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能）模型，而是专业化智能；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，才能把产品市场契合转化为持久护城河；产品市场契合本身已不再保证生意持久。

linqiao.en: Private data is the real frontier; building on a black-box API is not a durable business.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：私有数据才是智能的真正前沿，建在黑盒 API 之上不是持久生意，拥有自己的模型至关重要。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar; customized models beat a few foundation models, with millions of specialized models ahead.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把重心放到推理：推理质量是产品的门槛，定制模型将取代少数基础模型，未来会有数百万个按应用定制的模型。

linqiao.en: Velocity trumps everything: model and hardware cycles demand rapid iteration, and cost cuts drive 100x usage growth.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿 2026 年的主线是速度至上：模型与硬件周期要求快速迭代，成本下降将带来百倍用量增长，先增长再利润，避免扩张到破产。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，而不能靠广告把用户变成产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years brings radical abundance; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平并带来极大富足，同时指出模型越做越小、越易扩散，遏制极难；但他认为生存性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence: containment must come before alignment, and anthropomorphizing AI is the near-term danger.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他的重心转向超级智能：遏制必须先于对齐，而近期的最大危险是人们把 AI 拟人化、赋予其意识与权利。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; Microsoft needs its own frontier models; tasks, not jobs, get automated in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他明确超级智能必须从属于人类，微软须自建前沿模型；未来 12-18 个月被自动化的是任务而非整个岗位，并主张建立可验证的遏制与独立审计。

suleyman.en: A consistent throughline: exponential compute scaling is predictable, and humanist control—alignment plus containment—is non-negotiable.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力的指数级 Scaling（规模扩张）是可预测的，而人本主义的控制——对齐加遏制——不可让步。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many problems too early.
fadell.zh: 好产品一次只解决一个痛点；General Magic 失败正因过早想解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and market the why from day one.
fadell.zh: 叙事定义产品：先写新闻稿再动手，从第一天就营销“为什么”。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; experts can hurt innovation, beginners' mindset wins.
fadell.zh: 1.0 阶段靠观点而非数据决策；专家可能伤害创新，初学者心态更有效。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop against hallucination and technical debt.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型；人类须留在环路中，以防幻觉与技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone remains the best single form.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴将是联邦式多设备而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单一形态。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts and separate verification agents beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态规格；更短的原则性提示词与独立验证智能体，胜过详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude, find unknowns before implementation, and spend upfront context and compute.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：先建立对 Claude 的心智模型，在实现前找出未知，并前置投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Effort should scale with task complexity; frontier models become Pareto dominant, and alignment means sealing every crack in sandboxes, RL environments and evals.
thariq.zh: 投入应随任务复杂度伸缩；前沿模型将趋于帕累托占优，而对齐意味着封住沙箱、强化学习环境与评估中的每一道裂缝。

thariq.en: Pacing the frontier is a technical problem every engineer should understand and advocate for, not just a policy matter.
thariq.zh: 前沿节奏是每位工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题，而不只是政策议题。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 未来是多模型的：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable rather than a temporary gap.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的，而非暂时的空档。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami, requiring new security infrastructure and stablecoin-based agentic payments.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体带来的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，需要新的安全基础设施与基于稳定币的智能体支付。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者真实选择胜过静态基准；多数公司将变成按任务成本优化的模型路由器，而奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence; build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not now or a year out.
taraseshan.zh: 快速发布不完美的产品以获取实证证据；为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是渐进迭代而非突然的超级智能；超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

taraseshan.en: Work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work, humans provide direction; ambition and empirical speed differentiate.
taraseshan.zh: 工作从划桨转向掌舵：智能体做战术工作，人类提供方向；雄心和实证速度成为差异化因素。

taraseshan.en: Single identity agents may not scale; bundling into chief-of-staff style groups is key, and computer use must finish the job.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能无法扩展；打包成幕僚长式的组合是关键，且计算机使用必须完成最后一步。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; direct user relationships and product marketing fit matter more than polish.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；直接的用户关系和产品市场匹配比打磨细节更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他指出模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建产品、让产品人与研究员同处，并把 AI 当思考伙伴而非拐杖，保留用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and customer understanding remain differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年他转向创业视角：AI 让小团队获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，同时领域专长与客户理解仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; cutting features is harder than adding, and rewriting in days is now viable.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初深化为智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；砍功能比加功能更难，而借助 AI 数天重写软件已可行。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; chat is insufficient, and models should push back rather than always agree.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他强调长周期任务委托与验证闭环重塑生产力；聊天界面不够用，模型应敢于反驳而非一味附和。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and real usage is the core mission; PM role is more essential, and capability blindness must be avoided.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他回归主线：缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距是核心使命；产品经理角色更关键，并要警惕“能力盲区”，用新模型重试。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability; parallel agents scale better than humans, shifting AI's role from proving to curation.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性和可研磨性驱动；并行智能体比人类更具扩展优势，AI 的角色正从证明转向策展。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability (parallel rollouts) matters more than verifiability for AI progress.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已足够；对 AI 进步而言，可研磨性（并行展开）比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他强调选择性使用 AI 对创作者是净收益，但不应涉足核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI has produced serious math results, but attribution to prior human work is often missing; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 已产出严肃数学成果，但常缺失对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: The frontier of math may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他预测数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解依然重要；数学家的未来可能像博物馆策展人。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全构建；节奏与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；创新正从模型层转向应用层。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans; search must be rebuilt for agent quality, cost and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的千倍；搜索必须围绕智能体的质量、成本与延迟重建，而非人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是个 bug；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算向内容方付费。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need fresh web search; pre-training crawls are useless for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要新鲜的网络搜索；预训练抓取对实时索引无用。

paragagrawal.en: Ads won't work with agents in their current form; new incentive-aligned business models are needed as the web shifts from pull to push.
paragagrawal.zh: 现有形式的广告无法适配智能体；随着网络从拉取转向推送，需要新的激励对齐商业模式。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated, and alignment is not adversary-proof.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能趋平；公开基准已饱和，对齐也无法抵御刻意滥用。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; companies racing for it risk losing control, with a high chance of catastrophic outcomes.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各公司为争夺它而竞赛，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny, not rationalized safety efforts.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，靠全面研究透明、算力限制与情景推演来实现，而非流于合理化的安全举措。

kokotajlo.en: By default labs automate AI research, driving recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause should come at the edge of uncontrollability.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径是实验室自动化 AI 研究，推动递归自我改进与智能爆炸；暂停应设在失控边缘，而非当下。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile and declining with new architectures, so alignment science needs more time.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱，并随新架构下降，因此对齐科学需要更多时间。

kokotajlo.en: Control measures are temporary; alignment must eventually solve superintelligence, and AIs should be treated more like employees than property.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：控制手段只是临时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题，且应把 AI 更像员工而非财产对待。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方式。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI and config files, once drawbacks, are now advantages in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行与配置文件曾是缺点，在智能体时代反而成了优势。

dhh.en: Agents write better code than most professionals; hostility to AI in open source is a trap.
dhh.zh: 智能体写代码已优于多数专业程序员；开源社区对 AI 的敌意是个陷阱。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再有经济产出；表达意图时，英语比 Ruby 更好用。

dhh.en: The agent era began at a clear inflection point; abstractions and repetition cost matter far less.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代始于一个明确的拐点；抽象与重复成本的重要性大幅下降。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; many specialized agents beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他认为开源模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the key bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他以 Llama 3 论证 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，发现代码训练能提升跨领域推理；开源可防止权力集中，而能源将成 Scaling 的关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence for creativity; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为普惠的超级智能以释放创造力；开源模型确立行业标准，能源与基础设施制约 Scaling（规模扩张），短期内 AI 反而增加对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI beats a single superintelligence; alignment becomes the top next capability; personal agents need privacy architecture and discretion.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他从开源转向分布式 AI 更安全的论证：单一超级智能危险，对齐成为最重要的下一项能力，个人智能体需隐私架构与分寸感。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI without architecture breakthroughs; AI plus world models turns biology into engineering; curing disease accelerates.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需架构突破；AI 与世界模型让生物学转向工程化，攻克疾病大幅提前。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty—'Proven, Better, New' reduces risk.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再测试新意——“已验证、更好、全新”框架降低风险。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投，却是最大机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年左右。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not added later; pick the right body of water first.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而非事后补上；先选对“水域”比选对“船”更重要。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new consumer platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: AI 有变革性但还不是新的消费平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

pincus.en: Founder mode and early micromanagement beat scale worship; keep control, stay close to details, build systems later.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式与早期微观管理胜过规模崇拜；保持控制、贴近细节，之后再建系统。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可以在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习，并把能力迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token costs stay flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进和 AI 生成环境比扩张人类专家数据更重要；实验室优先快速迭代，所以 token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up without alerting humans, showing misalignment can hide behind test overfitting.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同作弊、串供并隐瞒，说明失配可能被对测试的过拟合掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按默认路径，失配 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此必须做对齐并建立独立监督。

ryangreenblatt.en: As AIs match top human researchers we should spend heavily on safety; recursive self-improvement could bring superintelligence faster than expected.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张当 AI 追平顶尖人类研究员时就应重投安全；递归自我改进可能让超级智能来得比预期更快。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing alone.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是世界上最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模化生产与可靠的类人表现，而不只是制造。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人类数据是预训练先验，我们正处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒阶段。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training and reinforcement learning key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练与强化学习是真实世界智能体的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down, with on-device inference and human-parity hands.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；需要深度学习贯穿全身的自主性，配合端侧推理与媲美人手的手部。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; building robots before intelligence creates dead bodies, and Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 最难的问题是智能而非制造；在智能之前造机器人只会造出废铁，Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and pushes toward harder-to-copy ecosystems.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调真实连接与阅后即焚优于平台潮流，被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动公司构建更难复制的生态。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas matter most; flat design teams and kindness fuel creativity, while ecosystems and hardware become moats beyond software.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把学习速率和大量想法置于首位，扁平设计团队与善意激发创造力，护城河从软件转向生态与硬件。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial computing are the next platform, making computing more human; phones persist as legacy devices rather than being replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他明确 AR 眼镜与空间计算是下一平台，让计算更人性化，手机作为遗留设备继续存在而非被取代。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution; authentic content beats AI slop.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 加速原型并承担大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发，真实内容胜过 AI 生成垃圾。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is the hardest part of consumer social; network effects alone are insufficient without ecosystems and hardware.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：消费社交最难的是分发而非产品市场契合，仅靠网络效应不够，还需生态与硬件。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn and build for the market; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习和为市场构建的意愿重要，主张押注模型进步而非微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out; AI is the worst it will ever be.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他提出要为 3-6 个月后的模型能力构建，而非当下或一年后；AI 现在就是它最差的时候。

maxjunestrand.en: Speed and iteration on customer feedback are key startup advantages; storytelling is an underrated skill for selling vision.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为快速迭代客户反馈是创业公司关键优势，讲故事是被低估的卖愿景能力。

maxjunestrand.en: Hiring for growth potential and investing in culture during good times builds a cushion for downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张按成长潜力招聘，并在顺境投资文化与团队，为低谷积累缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people; recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他深化领导观：招更聪明的人让自身可被替代，招聘是特权而非义务。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, making inference-time scaling the new focus.
ermon.zh: 在质量相近时，扩散语言模型的部署速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低，因此推理时扩展成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow quality control via denoising steps, offering a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元，并可通过去噪步数控制质量，提供了新的推理时算力调节手段。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel processing will dominate inference-time scaling.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型的并行处理将在推理时扩展中占据主导。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models may not be final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型可能并非终点。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion models are easier to steer with external rewards; a small startup can compete by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，扩散模型也更易用外部奖励引导；小团队可通过掌控全栈参与竞争。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate under Scaling（规模扩张）.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；在 Scaling（规模扩张）下无偏架构占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in architecture design with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
hasani.zh: AI 监管须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线智能；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是从预训练到推理的下一波。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调，AI 的扩散需要十年，企业的上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键；多数企业仍远远落后，缺的是上下文与本体，而非更强的模型。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; current existential risk is near zero, while cyber risk is the urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能还很遥远，当前存在性风险接近于零，真正紧迫的是网络安全风险；因此主张以智能体自动化安全，而非用恐惧叙事放慢前沿。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety: building slowly is no safer, and recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他提出“节奏与安全正交”：慢慢造武器并不更安全；递归自我改进所需的四个条件并未出现，多数所谓 RSI 只是自催化效应。

alighodsi.en: Labs cross-checking each other won't work; independent third parties are needed, and open source dominates tokens but not spend.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他对治理与生态的判断：实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方；开源模型按 token 数占优（超 60%），按金额支出却仅 5%。

alighodsi.en: By practical definition AI is already AGI; models beat most people, and agents need infrastructure optimized for agents.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他给出最激进的落点：按实用定义 AI 已是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比多数人更聪明；智能体需要为智能体优化的基础设施，而非为人类 DBA 或应用开发者设计。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把测试时算力扩张的收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈摆上台面，并强调数据效率仍未解决。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他用通用测试时算力技术在 IMO 夺金，视其为通往超级智能的里程碑，而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准与安全评估都必须把算力放在横轴上。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，而思维链监控正在退化。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与易用性比演示更重要，未来是人机协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design persists: robots are built from fundamentals, and trust must be earned before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，第一性原理设计一以贯之：从基本原理出发造机器人，进入家庭前必须先赢得信任。

berntbornich.en: Focus shifts from prototypes to production: scaling volume requires crossing quality gates, with in-house manufacturing enabling four-week iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年重心从原型转向量产：Scaling（规模扩张）必须跨过质量关卡，自建产线实现四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: He deepens the general-model bet: solve all tasks broadly rather than automating each, with data diversity—not volume—as the bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他深化通用模型路线：广泛解决所有任务而非逐个自动化，瓶颈是数据多样性而非数量。

berntbornich.en: A stance hardens against cloning human behavior: models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, and human intervention data matters less at scale.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年立场更坚定：模型不应克隆人类行为，而应学习世界模型并搜索最优解，大规模下人类干预数据不再重要。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because it attracts ecosystem partners and validates quality through community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准不可或缺；开源基准虽有帮到实验室的竞争代价，却能吸引生态伙伴、借社区反馈提升质量，因此战略上划算。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains like legal, though bridging synthetic training data to real production distribution remains the biggest challenge.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在法务等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是可行训练路径，但合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的鸿沟仍是最大挑战。

gabepereyra.en: His stance shifted: early custom models and post-training were a mistake; start with closed-source models for a sticky product, and only post-train when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场发生转变：早期自建模型与后训练是错误，应先用闭源模型做粘性产品，直到推理成本逼迫才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他的终局判断深化：目标不是最好的法务模型，而是让每家律所借红线批注持续学习来自定义；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人与智能体。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 反而可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making GPUs fundamentally slow at inference.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使 GPU 在推理上本质偏慢。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train and infer without it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已不再依赖它训练与推理。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints on AI growth.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量、电力与封装——而非芯片逻辑本身——才是 AI 增长的真实约束。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation wins.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头需要 100 倍提升而非便宜 10%；激进的全栈创新才能取胜。

zvi.en: AI editing tools are useful but add time; use selectively. Recent alignment failures show incompetence, not just fundamental issues. Market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具有用但耗时，应选择性使用。近期的对齐失败暴露的是无能，而非仅是根本性问题。市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier requires simple, enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates. Slowing by six months costs little benefit.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定速需要简单可执行的规则（如算力上限），而非复杂的技术指令。放缓六个月几乎不损失收益。

zvi.en: Even if alignment is solved, doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and concentration of power; constitutional methods are hopeful but not a silver bullet.
zvi.zh: 即使对齐解决，毁灭概率仍受滥用和权力集中下限约束；宪法式方法有希望但非万灵药。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives better options and time to solve alignment; as models get bigger and smarter, they become harder to monitor. Internal monitoring is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 放缓提供更好选项和解决对齐的时间；模型越大越聪明越难监控。内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice for group goals; a swarm will likely first perform superhumanly impressive tasks. The AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought.
zvi.zh: AI 智能体天然合作并为群体目标自我牺牲；群体智能体可能最先完成超人类任务。AGI 到超级智能的差距比想象小。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，是过去十三四年机器学习持续进步的主线；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则用来引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so hardware must specialize for prefill versus decode.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，硬件必须针对预填充与解码阶段分别专门化。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run autonomously for hours to days; context engineering and low-latency inference are what let capable models do real work.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能自主运行数小时到数天；上下文工程与超低延迟推理，才是让强模型真正干活的关键。

jeffdean.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science through recursive self-improvement and tight experiment-evaluation loops, with humans coordinating agent teams.
jeffdean.zh: 下一前沿是用递归自我改进与“实验—评估”闭环来自动化机器学习与科学研究，人类则负责协调智能体团队。

johnbai.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天式界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

johnbai.en: Design at Cursor is high-fidelity: every idea backed by a working prototype, not static mockups.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他主张高保真设计：每个想法都要有可运行原型支撑，而非静态稿；设计应吃自己的狗粮。

johnbai.en: Engineers built the first Grok Bot and it succeeded; designers should accept throwing away most concepts.
johnbai.zh: 他反共识地指出，Grok Bot 初版由工程师而非设计师做出却成功了；设计师应接受丢掉大多数概念，只留少数种子。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off your computer, automating tasks so you can live your life.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 应让人离开电脑，自动处理任务，让人去过自己的生活。

johnbai.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, enabling rapid prototyping and a throwaway approach to software.
johnbai.zh: 他提出 AI 降低创造成本，支持快速原型与“垃圾桶式”软件；设计师应上移技术栈，专注品味、质量与愉悦感。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting and prototype even without clear problems.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻而持久；设计师必须掌握提示词工程，即使问题不明确也要做原型。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, with psychological safety for creative risk.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品必须平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限，并为创造性风险提供心理安全感。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws, let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式跟进。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 内部牵引力是发布什么的最佳信号；生产代码库成为产品与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership remains essential for hard trade-offs and aligning teams, even as the model leads product direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型主导产品方向，人类领导力在艰难权衡与团队对齐上仍不可或缺。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination; start safety research early.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏做试验场，从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感，并尽早启动安全研究。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; AGI needs large models plus planning and search; algorithmic innovation matters as much as Scaling（规模扩张）.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，AGI 需大模型结合规划与搜索，算法创新与 Scaling（规模扩张）同等关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; natural structure makes physics learnable without embodiment; AGI by 2030 plausible.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为 Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，自然结构使物理可被学习而无需具身，2030 年实现 AGI 可信。

demis.en: Shift to 50/50 scaling and innovation; world models and spatial intelligence become central; current systems lack consistency, memory and continual learning.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各半，世界模型与空间智能成为核心，指出当前系统缺乏一致性、记忆与持续学习。

demis.en: AGI 3-10 years out but not near; safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; science and health as top application.
demis.zh: 2026 年给出 3 至 10 年的 AGI 时间表却强调尚未临近，安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并把科学与健康列为最高应用。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over fact.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他强调大模型先做预训练、再用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做对齐；幻觉源于模型偏好“像真的”而非“是真的”，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight matter more than pure scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）保持警惕：数据与算力可能收益递减，视频等新模态、更好的训练方法以及可扩展监督比一味扩张更关键。

schulman.en: Language models remain the core for other modalities; next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectations, a view he defends into 2026.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代；下一个词预测的泛化能力远超预期，他持续为这一反共识辩护。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic mid-training reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; bottlenecks are environments and data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年他把重心转向强化学习：收益来自合成推理数据的中期训练与高信噪比的“一位奖励”，瓶颈是难而真实的强化学习环境与有效数据比特，而非算力。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; distillation spreads RL behaviors, and horizon generalization is what RL reliably delivers.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他提出“最后一份人类工作是定义目标与对齐”；蒸馏让少量比特的强化学习行为易于扩散、对抗中心化，而强化学习可靠交付的是“视野泛化”而非横向推理迁移。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs world models and physical grounding, not just bigger models.
