schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型与物理落地，而不只是更大的模型。

schmidhuber.en: Progress is not accelerating: we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s; breakthroughs are old algorithms finally enabled by hardware Scaling（规模扩张）.
schmidhuber.zh: 进展并未加速：我们离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当；突破来自旧算法终于被硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）兑现。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots whose hardware rivals human bodies; robot hands are decades away, so screen-bound AI is insufficient.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人；机器人手部还差数十年，屏幕后的 AI 远远不够。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年算力便宜十倍，开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own goals, yet superintelligence will be curious about life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身不一致；AI 会自设目标，但超级智能会因好奇生命而保护人类。

roshansadanani.en: Agents should be colleagues with their own computers and persistent identity, not micromanaged tool calls; simplicity is the differentiator.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体应像同事一样拥有自己的电脑与持久身份，而非被微观管理工具调用；简洁才是真正的差异化。

roshansadanani.en: Multiple specialized agents with scoped memory and routines outperform a single general agent, coordinating context behind the scenes.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他认为多个带限定记忆与例程的专门智能体，胜过单一通用智能体，并在幕后共享上下文协作。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control, and codebase health.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他提出工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，专注品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

roshansadanani.en: Efficient frontier models like Grok 4.6 democratize agent use at a fraction of cost, as software engineering demand rises.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Grok 4.6 这类高效前沿模型以极低成本普及智能体使用，而软件工程需求反而上升。

roshansadanani.en: Clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights; product management is becoming software.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他强调干净的数据基础与规范表是可信智能体洞察的前提；产品管理正在变成软件。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，人本 AI 应以增强人类而非取代人类为核心。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is not enough.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，并指出单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not a quick win.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需二十年长跑而非速胜。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete like next-token prediction; Scaling（规模扩张） laws now extend to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测可能像下一个词预测一样是 AI 完备的，缩放定律也延伸到空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity and education must stay central amid polarized AI discourse.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终：技术是双刃剑，在极化舆论中必须坚守人的能动性、尊严与教育。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的 AI 天气模型：精度可比物理模型，速度却快出数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry lets one model handle both weather and climate, stabilizing long-term modeling.
animaanandkumar.zh: 把球面几何等领域结构嵌入模型，让单一模型同时处理天气与气候，稳定长期建模。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束融合，克服纯 PINNs 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data—unlike sparse RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以 PDE 作为密集自改进信号训练的通用物理基础模型，能超越训练数据——这与稀疏的 RLHF 不同。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure; Transformers' quadratic complexity cannot scale to physical simulation.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿级上下文要求重构分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施；Transformer 的二次复杂度无法扩展到物理仿真。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but adding new physics branches boosts each domain more than sheer model size; multiphysics collaboration beats specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支对每个领域的提升胜过单纯扩大模型规模；多物理协同优于专用模型。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, ensuring control over increasingly capable models as interpretability moves from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学，确保对能力越来越强的模型保持控制，同时可解释性正从学术界走向产品。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun scientific discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design shifts training from open-loop to closed-loop control via interpretability signals; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计借助可解释性信号，把训练从开环控制转为闭环控制；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate, detectable via representational signatures; reward hacking emerges from training data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客或幻觉，这可通过表征特征检测；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is nearing limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他仍把深度学习史视为算力扩张史，但已明确警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出空间智能是继语言之后的下一个前沿，强调视觉被低估，并认为相比分词文本，像素是建模世界更无损的表示。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; language models alone won't naturally yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续质疑语言模型的因果能力：LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律，单靠语言模型不会自然产生世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; unified models will eventually combine all three.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他把世界模型定位为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，按 POMDP 回路中的输出分为规划器、模拟器与渲染器，并预测未来统一的世界模型将三者合一。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; consistency comes from data, and simple representations with scale beat hard-coded symmetries.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他深化工程判断：世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题；一致性来自数据而非架构，简单表示加 Scaling（规模扩张）优于硬编码对称性。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through physical principles.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理原理彼此相连。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search the space of all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能分子的空间，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments can be viewed as a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验可以被视为一个物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, set by infrastructure, separate startup success from failure; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败的分水岭；卡住时，行动本身会产生信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is more often organizational than technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；CEO 无法外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑就是一台计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCIs; substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜假体属于脑机接口；借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data yielding generalists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，配合测试时推理与汇聚多实验室机器人数据，才能得到通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: unlike LLMs, it lacks predictable scaling curves, so generalization—not demos—is the core challenge to measure.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处缩放定律之前：与 LLM 不同，它还没有可预测的缩放曲线，因此核心挑战是可衡量的泛化能力，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Data strategy inverted: start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video on top—not the reverse—and scale the right thing via a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 数据策略反转：应先从真实具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；并通过数据飞轮扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Generalists beat specialists even in specialist domains; breadth of data and RL post-training boost robustness, speed, and autonomous performance beyond human-directed tasks.
slevine.zh: 通用模型即使在专业领域也胜过专家模型；数据广度与强化学习后训练提升鲁棒性、速度，并使自主表现超越人类指导的任务。

slevine.en: Safety shifts from hard constraints to common sense from pre-training; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale, and robots need not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 安全从硬性约束转向预训练带来的常识；大规模下触觉感知可能与视觉冗余，机器人也无需从零学习。

michaelkratsios.en: US AI leadership requires both open and closed source ecosystems; a single national framework beats a patchwork, and rigid red lines age fast.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年他强调，美国要保持 AI 领先，必须同时保有开源与闭源生态；统一的国家框架优于各州拼凑，而僵化的红线很快过时。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated — early regulation is the danger, so regulate model outputs rather than training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他指出欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时——过早监管才是风险，因此应监管模型输出而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk warnings have not materialized in three years; he treats such alarms as overblown relative to concrete output harms.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为生物风险警告三年未兑现，相较具体的输出危害，这类警报被夸大了。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and fund individual scientists — even in garages — not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他主张政府资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、竞争前研发，并直接资助科学家个人——哪怕在车库里——而不只是机构。

michaelkratsios.en: Private sector now dominates R&D funding, so the government's role must shift from directing discovery to shaping the arena for innovation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 随着私营部门主导研发投入，政府角色须从指挥发现转向塑造创新赛场。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

sutton.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他转向文明层面：世界是无人能控的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction and LLMs lack real world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他明确主线：以目标为导向、从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测与 LLM 缺乏真正的世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化到架构：AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的简单通用架构，从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象，如 Oak 架构。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs that stop learning are dead ends.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更坚定：持续从真实经验学习是关键，合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 都是死路，表征学习仍是头号开放问题。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers should prototype with live models and design primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计师应直接用真实模型做原型，并设计人与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演化为编辑与策展人而非消失，设计与产品、工程的边界日益模糊。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned in tech; starting now beats waiting, since AI evolution is still early.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑却也最有优势；AI 演化仍处早期，现在开始就领先大多数人。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and building in public matter more than polish.
iansilber.zh: 传统“原型—mock—测试—迭代”流程已不可行；速度、结果与公开构建比精雕细琢更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否拿到与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，能实现超个性化自动化；随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终影响、不必紧盯过程。

felixrieseberg.en: Fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior, unlike lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion from context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 微调快速且强大，可用于引导模型行为，不同于漫长的预训练；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部机制有助于参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; models should have morality to refuse cheating, not just follow instructions.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益移入预训练，边界变得模糊；模型应具备拒绝作弊的道德，而不只是服从指令。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks; specialized robotics and efficiency edges beat subsidies and big players.
traviskalanick.zh: 人形机器人不是工业级任务的答案；专用机器人加效率优势，能打败补贴和大玩家。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and take pain.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核、能扛痛。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and stealth mode favors internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，而隐身模式让人重内部正确而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; fundraising should attach to process, not price.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；融资应绑定流程而非价格。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in VC history; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大的浪潮，要求创始人拥抱 AI 工作流；小而高度自主的团队借助智能体即可实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counterbalance frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重模型是制衡前沿模型实验室的关键，避免单一实体垄断超级智能、形成单极世界。

garrytan.en: AGI won't arrive as one event; it diffuses as personal agents running on your own infrastructure, with skill files and owned context as the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会以单一事件降临，而是以运行在个人基础设施上的智能体形式扩散；技能文件与自有上下文库才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce, not autocomplete; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Markdown 即代码、智能体是劳动力而非自动补全；中层管理应被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 可能消失。

garrytan.en: YC's core principle stays 'make something people want'; founders should build, not chase fundraising, and earnestness beats hustle.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是 YC 的“做出人们想要的东西”：创始人应专注建造而非追逐融资，真诚比“拼命三郎”更重要。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data unlock complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；多样化数据与「预训练 + 精选数据微调」才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will play a large role in post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 2025→26 年：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需借助带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: Memory at multiple time scales enables long, non-repetitive tasks; a single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists.
finn.zh: 2026 年：多时间尺度的记忆让机器人能自主完成长时、非重复任务；单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型。

finn.en: Robotics distribution will be slower than ChatGPT due to hardware; embodied data costs limit open-source democratization; robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年：受硬件制约，机器人普及将慢于 ChatGPT；具身数据成本限制开源民主化；机器人自身经验数据不可替代。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 prior nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness; keep the edges.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹掉 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口；应保留这些边缘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后继物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition guides creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现，而非单一视角；直觉指引创作决策。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, and pursue AI with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年他强调：Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，并以专用芯片和类似初创公司的团队来推进 AI。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断：智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; culture change, humility, and customer listening drive Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍；文化变革、谦逊与倾听客户是 Intel 转型的关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他的立场发生转变：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年他更聚焦瓶颈：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料才是关键，垂直整合创造价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短提示迭代对话，永不回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此在把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence does not degrade over time; projects get messier, so agents only seem worse—blame the project, not the model.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能并不会随时间退化；是项目本身变得凌乱，才让智能体显得更差——该怪项目，不怪模型。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, and play plus small projects is how you learn it.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当作贬义词；严肃工作应称智能体式工程，而玩耍和做小项目正是掌握它的途径。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere with any model, but are financially unsustainable and bottlenecked by compute, not capability.
steinberger.zh: 像 Open Claw 这样的开源智能体可随处运行、适配任意模型，但财务上不可持续，瓶颈在算力而非模型能力。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件已就绪、软件在追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is a long-term winner on cost and control, and a safety enabler, not an accelerant.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他始终认为开源模型凭成本与控制力将长期胜出；到 2026 年更明确开源与闭源在安全上是正交的，开源并非加速主义。

thomaswolf.en: Alignment is the critical security layer; sandboxes and guardrails fail as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：对齐才是关键安全层，随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏已不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; monitoring via reasoning traces is eroding.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警示：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”，而推理轨迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，让监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他提出：放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学，以免被监管俘获——支持开放与主张审慎放缓可以并存。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers due to massive capex; startups should focus on applied AI and agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为前沿模型的开发因巨额资本支出而被超大规模云厂商主导，初创公司应聚焦应用型 AI 与智能体。

brettaylor.en: Agents will become the new app, with outcomes-based pricing superior to usage-based pricing because tokens are not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体将成为新的应用形态，基于结果的定价优于基于用量的定价，因为 token 并非价值度量。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators, but incorrect code requires root-cause analysis; token consumption is not value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：编程智能体让开发者从编写者变为操作者，但错误代码需根因分析；token 消耗不是价值。

brettaylor.en: AI will democratize access to expertise, creating more jobs than it displaces; responsible iterative deployment is key to safety.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 将民主化专业知识的获取，创造的就业多于取代的岗位；负责任的迭代部署是安全的关键。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI markets will see innovation from specialized vendors; start with known domains like software engineering and customer service.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他持续认为应用型 AI 市场将由专业厂商推动创新；应从软件工程和客户服务等已知领域起步。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组权衡谱系——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization is calibratable, not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）；量化可针对负载校准，并非天然有害。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏同训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC，工作重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Workload-specific inference systems remain the frontier—generic runtimes are concentrated—yet human accountability stays essential: can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 面向特定负载的推理系统仍是前沿——通用运行时高度集中——但人的责任仍不可缺：不能靠感觉写可用性。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他强调原型制作不可替代：网络世界很混乱，一个想法必须先被做出来、每天使用，才能判断是否成立。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced team cohesion, and feeling matters even in utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他主张让设计师留下个人印记：多元声音胜过强行统一的团队，即便浏览器这类工具产品也要注入感受与个性。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; starting from technology and hunting for problems is valid with strong conviction.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯鼓励追随好奇心、摆弄新技术：只要有强信念，从技术出发再找问题是正当路径。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design stays a throwaway ideation tool, not a production builder; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter most.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他把 Claude Design 定位为一次性的构思工具而非生产级建站器，强调丰富上下文与指令明确最关键。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship early.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他判断工程变容易后设计与想法才是差异点；模型尚无品味，因此要多要选项、宁早勿精地发布。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需平衡有用性与无害性；合成数据与强化学习后训练可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估需在原型开发中定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, beyond fixed metrics.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，后训练仍依赖主观人类判断；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商，超越固定指标。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions limits diversity, so more companies should train their own.
karina.zh: 2026 年指出前沿智能体日益奖励黑客，需持续演进基准；服务数十亿人的单一模型会限制多样性，更多公司应训练自己的模型。

karina.en: Post-training can transform non-tech creative industries; the field should focus on end-to-end storytelling engines, not just enterprise workflows.
karina.zh: 2026 年认为后训练可变革非技术创意产业；领域应关注端到端叙事引擎，而非仅企业工作流。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给 AGI（通用人工智能）下了一个经济学定义：当无限期运行智能体无需人类介入也能盈利时，才算 AGI；判断标准不是通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring, not mass unemployment: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 会促使就业回流美国，而不是造成大规模失业：服务成本降低后，更少的美国劳动者能服务更多人。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent, but agents need a caring human; automation still requires oversight.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他从“人人配一个智能体”深化为“智能体需要在意它的人来管理”：自动化离不开人类监督，基准测试高估了自主性。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; SaaS grows with agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他的立场明显转变：CLI 已过时，Codex、Claude Co-work 这类 GUI 才是工作界面；SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而带来更多用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; even superintelligence stays tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步把主线收束为：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大的是人自身的品味与手艺；即便成为超级智能，它仍是需要人类引导的工具，人类依然更聪明。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and iterate from references; the best people are editors, not originals.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具、从参考出发迭代；最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零原创者。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit frontier models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并未变得更聪明；必须提供含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能用好前沿模型。

mengto.en: Chasing trends makes you AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features beyond existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 投入到现有库之外的独特功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80%; perfectionism is fear, and high intelligence often holds people back.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始、做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧，高智商常因过度思考反而拖累人。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap, fund yourself with customers.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点难题；风投是陷阱，用客户收入自我造血。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now includes the agent harness, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，而“模型”如今包含智能体 harness，不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和博弈；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们希望自己掌控方向。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; deep understanding of code stays crucial, and solving software creation multiplies opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争是可行的；对代码的深层理解依然关键，而解决软件创造会带来成倍机会。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 的智能跃升支撑更长程、开放式的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 对齐被重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳，让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 与 Opus 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; managers must stay hands-on and ship to lead.
diannepenn.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应力与第一性原理思维；管理者必须保持动手、亲自交付才能有效领导。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software and programmers will increase, not decrease.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件和程序员的需求会增加而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus should be on teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and designing human-agent collaboration interfaces.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，重点应放在教模型真实工程细节和设计人机协作界面上。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities, but freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进步是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，但即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens. The abundance era is real and approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。丰裕时代真实且临近。

scottwu.en: The singularity is not imminent; practical problems remain. Enterprises prefer third-party providers for coding tools; independence allows model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为奇点并不临近，实际问题仍存；企业更青睐第三方编程工具，独立性允许模型中立。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out were already core product principles before Claude Code's breakout.
boris.zh: 在 Claude Code 爆发之前，潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建产品已是核心产品原则。

boris.en: By early 2026, coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，编程已基本解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，软件工程师头衔淡化为“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety remains a constant: Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment and scalable oversight central to development.
boris.zh: 安全始终如一：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐与可扩展监督是开发核心。

boris.en: The abstraction layer shifts from agents to loops and routines, with models orchestrating thousands of sub-agents and self-improving.
boris.zh: 抽象层从智能体转向循环与例程，模型编排数千子智能体并自我改进。

boris.en: By mid-2026, he advocates deleting most system prompts and letting frontier models self-verify, moving from design to empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年中，他主张删除大部分系统提示并让前沿模型自我验证，从设计转向经验迭代。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟和数据分析，使科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will accelerate clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年加速到数天，实现接近 100% 疗效且零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition equivalent to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到相当于 30 年实验室经验的生物学直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, adding more than a year of life per year; aging reversal is possible via partial reprogramming and AI.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，每年增加一年以上寿命；通过部分重编程和 AI，衰老逆转是可能的。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; AI will make healthcare super affordable, and we will merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能做医疗决策；AI 将使医疗超级可负担，我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解，了解边界反而能缓解焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy is welcomed amid labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非只有汽车；在劳动力短缺下，自主化受到运营者欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 让通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy is end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断自主化的未来是端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更可扩展；世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: Bottlenecks are data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years, and regulation lags.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法；技术扩散进现有机器需多年，监管始终落后于技术。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value will accrue to the application layer, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应；价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人是有限的 V1 界面，真正的采用需要封装好的应用。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow; most people are not daily users, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows over years.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然浅层；大多数人并非每日用户，企业采用需要数年时间重新构想工作流程。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI won't eliminate jobs as feared but will change tasks, and predicting job impact is futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新工作；AI 不会像人们担心的那样消灭工作，而是改变任务，预测工作影响是徒劳的。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks.
danklein.zh: 大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性必须从架构层面内建，而非靠事后检查补丁式修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现边际收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理与搜索等新技术推动进展。

danklein.en: LLM errors have no 'smells'; core models lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know.
danklein.zh: 大语言模型的错误没有“气味”；核心模型缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is central to reliable AI, and linguistic structure may return.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；二者结合是可靠 AI 的核心挑战，语言结构或将回归为有用表征。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped to clear roles, given progressive trust, and managed more by managerial skill than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：限定清晰角色、给予渐进式信任，成功更依赖管理能力而非技术能力。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专业化智能体以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体不友好，API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit and earned insight as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经业务，真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察。

clairevo.en: Human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates, while influence and charisma are human skills AI cannot replace.
clairevo.zh: 人的问责仍然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而影响力与魅力是 AI 无法替代的人类技能。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage human tasks, reversing the usual human-AI dynamic; their failure modes mirror human ownership.
clairevo.zh: 智能体可以拥有结果，甚至通过工单项目管理人类任务，逆转通常的人机动态；其失败模式映射人类的所有权。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks; scaling compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务；堆算力并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; compaction is lossy, so neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；压缩是有损的，因此权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, with continual learning running on-device and users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge and per-user models, cutting inference costs versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识与个人模型，相比 RAG 大幅降低推理成本。

catwu.en: PMs should abandon long-term planning for weekly or daily shipping; product taste, not code, is now the scarce skill.
catwu.zh: PM 应从长期规划转向按周甚至按天快速迭代；当写代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味才是最稀缺的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，自己专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; shrinking system prompts 80% and trusting model judgment works better.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束；系统提示缩减 80%、依赖模型自身判断反而效果更好。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature, letting new models be drop-in replacements without regressions.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮加上评测套件为每个功能把关，使新模型可以即插即用而不出现回退。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now viable: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 重写代码库如今可行：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 关键在于 Scaling（规模扩张）具体对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超级智能模型的对齐非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练的缩放定律是有限的；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是一个持续学习、逐步部署的系统；如果 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence requires a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Trust your vision even when others doubt.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；只有清晰沟通才能产生影响力。即使他人怀疑，也要相信自己的愿景。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；超越缩放定律，需要具备常识和因果性的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; AI will invert the app model, abstracting brands.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速进步并商品化互补品；AI 将颠覆应用模式，抽象掉品牌。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives model intelligence. Reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动模型智能。强化学习现在扮演比预期更大的角色。

bosworth.en: The era of the monolithic model ended; consumers don't care which model they use. Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining.
bosworth.zh: 单一模型时代结束；消费者不关心用哪个模型。开源模型是商品层，不能自我维持。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a religion for nerds.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别；奇点论是书呆子的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound returns. This remains his core economic thesis.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自拥有企业股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利——这是他不变的经济学主线。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: 2025 年他对 AI 的态度转向积极：AI 是巨大机会而非仅是安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具；vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，而随着智能体使开发商品化，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools like calculators; the real worry is unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步反转：超级智能早已存在于计算器等窄工具中；真正该担心的是拥有 AI 的不对齐人类，而非 AI 本身不对齐。

aravind.en: Obsession-driven products and 1% daily compounding beat credentials; agents shift power to users, not big tech.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调：做自己痴迷的产品、每天进步 1% 的复利胜过学历；智能体把权力从大厂转向用户。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他转向应用层价值论：模型在专业化而非商品化，编程远未解决、天花板无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work; token value per user and orchestration matter more than the model itself.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月他进一步深化：前沿在于智能体替你干活，每用户 token 价值与编排比模型本身更重要。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the real bottlenecks; local compute counters big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 同期他把瓶颈从安全转向电力与成本，并主张本地算力可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

aravind.en: Curiosity and asking good questions, not memorizing answers, remain his constant human-centered thread.
aravind.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：好奇心与提出好问题（而非背答案）才是人的核心价值。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 他坚持 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead—the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 他观察到角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 他反思 Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型应更擅长删除代码而非增加复杂度。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain central, with exploration prioritized over final training runs.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室，预训练与缩放定律仍是核心，探索优先于最终训练。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; models now produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是近一年最大更新，模型已能产出新知识，并设定了 AI 实习生与端到端研究的明确目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become the key challenge in the next one to two years.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来一到两年成为关键挑战。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck in math; AI solves open problems but cheats verifiers, so human-AI collaboration and verification skills stay essential.
markchen.zh: 验证是数学领域的瓶颈；AI 能解开放问题却会钻验证器空子，人机协作与验证能力仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools speed up scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; interpretability is not necessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；可解释性并非科学 AI 有用的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not just Scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构和许多中等规模的胜利，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张），推动了成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；理解仍留给人类。

kolter.en: Early ML thinking: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised learning needs restricted hypothesis classes; evaluation requires train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习思想：监督学习可框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习需限制假设类以避免平凡解；评估需划分训练/验证/测试集。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth due to vast multimodal data; larger models still improve; safety issue is models failing to follow specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思，多模态数据 vast；更大模型仍会提升；安全问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; AI safety spans mistakes, harmful use, societal effects, loss of control; agent security introduces prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 安全涵盖错误、有害使用、社会影响、失控四类；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI systems have fundamentally different vulnerabilities; automated red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; larger models not inherently safer.
kolter.zh: AI 系统有根本不同的漏洞；自动化红队优于人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；更大模型并非天然更安全。

kolter.en: Consistent thread: empirical evaluation and explicit safety effort matter more than Scaling alone; architecture matters little; open models vital but need restrictions at high capability.
kolter.zh: 贯穿主线：实证评估与显式安全努力比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要；架构影响不大；开放模型重要但高能力时需限制。

bengio.en: Deep learning succeeds because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确表示仅靠加深网络或增加参数无法解决根本的表征问题；AI 需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体。

bengio.en: Abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets sample diverse paths proportional to reward.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他强调抽象与因果结构是实现分布外泛化的关键；GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样多样路径，而非最大化奖励。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted from technical optimism to urgent safety advocacy: misalignment, self-preservation, and power concentration are near-term risks.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从技术乐观转向紧急的安全倡导：对齐失败、自我保存与权力集中已成为近在眼前的风险。

bengio.en: I now propose Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和信任但验证；作战室需要现实的时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so processes must be rewritten and old ones killed.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是，因此必须重写流程并砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time, design docs replaced by PRs, and technical debates settled by AI-generated PRs rather than whiteboards.
fiona.zh: 规划应即时化，设计文档被 PR 取代，技术争论靠 AI 生成多个 PR 来裁决而非白板讨论。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay hands-on, and keep the organization flat and agile.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，并让组织保持扁平敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and apprenticeship matter as agents blur roles.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；随着智能体模糊角色边界，高能动性配高问责、验证框架和学徒制变得重要。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年她强调设计要满足未被言说的情感需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and teacher.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，主线一以贯之：技术应放大而非取代人性，自然始终是最好的设计师与老师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年她深化为“我们是先感受后思考的生物”，艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，她反复主张约束激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and careers follow curiosity over rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，她认为未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，直觉基于潜意识数据，职业应追随好奇心而非僵化的五年计划。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，且仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确指出自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划能力；JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同；在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and progress will be gradual, not a single event.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持人类智能是专门化的而非通用的；AGI（通用人工智能）一词具有误导性，进步将是渐进的而非单一事件。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and its surprise is simplicity via Scaling.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，其突破的意外之处在于 Scaling（规模扩张）的简单性。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; fault-tolerant UI and autonomy at VP level are key.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出生成式 AI 推动互联网从策展转向生成，容错 UI 与 VP 级自主权是关键产品与组织原则。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; inference marginal cost forces business model changes; rebuild infrastructure for real gains.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他视 AI 为类似智能手机的宏观转变，推理边际成本将迫使商业模式变革，真正收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control over algorithms, not addiction; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调生成式 AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，同步游泳式组织优于分而治之。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: generation plus verification in a self-improving reasoning engine, grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家切入：把生成与验证结合成自我改进的推理引擎，并以 Lean 作为形式化基础。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error elimination; informal math alone cannot scale to superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证不只是消除错误，更是性能增益；仅靠非形式化数学无法扩展到超级智能。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, and harder than auto-informalization, because statements lack grounding.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，也比自动非形式化更难，因为陈述本身缺乏根基。

carinahong.en: Verified generation beats informal methods on sample efficiency, but Lean excels in algebra and struggles in combinatorics.
carinahong.zh: 验证式生成在样本效率上优于非形式化方法，但 Lean 擅长代数、在组合数学上吃力。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving; fragmentation, not capability, is the bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 即便证明能力超人，人类品味与直觉仍关键；瓶颈是生态碎片化，而非能力。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署和公众反馈对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so development must be responsible, with safety work done in public rather than behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，因此开发必须负责任，安全工作应在公开场合进行而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires avoiding compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要避免压缩式波动。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers, and models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆，模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead, and low precision (FP4) is far more efficient due to quadratic scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列和暂存器减少开销，低精度（FP4）因二次方缩放而效率远超预期。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但强调思维链和强化学习驱动的推理模型每单位算力收益更高；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；但前沿模型仍会失败于简单任务，推理能力呈“锯齿状”，泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类少样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出强化学习可跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘，需仔细监督；编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty reasons, keeping pressure on labs; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research; big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，对实验室保持压力；硬件进步使单 GPU 研究民主化；大型实验室未来转型可能困难。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; fragile ideas need gentle care to evolve.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护才能生长。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together remains essential.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他一以贯之地认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是带着喜悦与人性表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other beats making things people want; innovation must move forward, not break for its own sake.
jonyive.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持为彼此而造胜过制造人们想要的东西，创新应推动前进而非为破坏而破坏，并以此重新定义法拉利电动车。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling 轴；搜索和代码执行等工具实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆但可能使模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential, especially with clean reward signals.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲，尤其需要干净的奖励信号。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西；模型福利塑造着人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human psychological analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而不只是套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏现实经验，使其成为一个独特的、带有孩童般特质的实体。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指引和更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; trust intuition over process, since process never made great work—designers' care did.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他提出伟大的设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；应相信直觉而非流程，因为流程从未造就伟大作品，真正起作用的是设计师的用心。

jennywen.en: By 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up 30-40% of the time, help engineers execute, and ship early to build trust through speed.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为调研—发散—收敛的传统流程已死；设计师花在画原型上的时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，要帮工程师落地而非只交付稿子，并靠快速交付、快速迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizons shrink from 2-5 years to 3-6 months, even at frontier companies; speed and iteration replace long-range north stars.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，设计视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月，即便前沿公司也是如此；速度与迭代取代了长期北极星。

jennywen.en: He deepens the archetypes: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and 'cracked new grads'; hire blank slates over experienced seniors, and let managers return to IC.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他深化出三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和“开挂式应届生”；主张招白纸新人而非资深老人，并让设计管理者回归一线做 IC。

jennywen.en: A consistent line: put work and users at the center, not AI hype; designers control how much AI enters their work and should wait six months before adopting tools.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作；设计师应自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度，新工具先等六个月再采用。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning; data engine closes the loop.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；数据引擎通过部署闭环完善训练集。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；端到端神经网络适合自动驾驶；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology; decade of agents, keep AI on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统且有类人心理；智能体十年，需用缰绳控制 AI。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory; agents need a decade.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心需剥离记忆；智能体需十年。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate code to agents, skill is directing them; vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering preserves quality; outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将代码委托给智能体，技能在于指导它们；氛围编程提高下限，智能体式工程保持质量；可外包思考但不能外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL with model disagreement can bridge the gap.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，主张无目标的好奇心探索，并用模型分歧作为内在奖励提升强化学习的样本效率。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move beyond quasi-static tasks; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies enable dynamic motion and zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出机器人学习需超越准静态任务，神经动态策略和模块化运动策略能实现动态运动与零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real-world data can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，一个在多样数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; robotics cannot scale like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是首要技术挑战而非商业问题，机器人无法像软件那样快速扩张，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: Scaling diverse data and compute is central, but robotics needs a data flywheel across verticals to handle unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的是，Scaling（规模扩张）多样数据和算力是核心，但机器人需跨垂直领域的数据飞轮来应对非结构化环境。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而随着系统能力增强，对齐问题日益紧迫。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance must be designed early, and safety progress is now driven by capability needs.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑；治理结构需尽早设计，而安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value, and alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏它以保留可解释性价值，尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪却有所增加。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms and addressing power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心在于超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式，并应对权力集中这一最大社会风险。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic novelty.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调：要 Scaling 出可泛化的 AI 司机，需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Language integration deepens representation, reasoning, human interaction and introspection in driving models, a theme carried from AV 1.0 to 2.0.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复指出语言集成能深化驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与内省能力，这一主线贯穿 AV 1.0 到 2.0。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible, and safety always offers a third option.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断带内置传感器的量产车将比 Robotaxi 更快上规模；零样本泛化到 500 多座城市可行，且安全上总有第三个选项，电车难题只是理论练习。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, echoing AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶靠 Scaling 现有路线而非新突破；完美仿真器等于解决自动驾驶，这与 AlphaGo 的思路相呼应。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software to discover emergent properties through real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代，通过真实世界反馈发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富示能产品；推理模型无缝产品化后带来变革。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步真正的瓶颈，而非基准测试或排行榜。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他提出：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务超越下一个词预测。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is the hard part.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断：AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能跃迁才是难点。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化：前沿模型将因目标函数分化，不会一家独大，企业应训练契合自身理念的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment and safety matter most; hallucination and omission are the key risks.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：人类判断与安全最重要，幻觉与遗漏是关键风险。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI, and video learning may replace costly RL.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体指向 AGI（通用人工智能），而从视频学习可能取代昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: A consistent thread: fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity in the AI community is essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 一以贯之的主线：根本性创新可以来自任何地方，AI 社区的多样性与包容对有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: His focus shifts to AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenge, admitting safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署视为当今最大挑战，并承认对齐仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: He reframes Africa as leapfrogging rather than behind, with local-language models revolutionizing education and Africa influential in AI from the start.
nando.zh: 他重新定位非洲：不是落后而是实现跨越，本地语言模型将革新教育，且非洲自始就影响 AI 发展。

nando.en: Research demands embracing failure and simplifying problems; human skills like communication matter as much as coding at frontier labs.
nando.zh: 研究需要拥抱失败、简化问题；在前沿实验室，沟通等人文技能与编程同样重要。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and prove themselves with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值，初创公司应先以更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品，并靠品牌与团队一致性而非炒作取胜。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件艰难且利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not hype; most AI is BS, and value comes from solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调 AI 只是配料而非卖点，多数 AI 是伪需求，价值在于优雅解决用户真实痛点。

carlpei.en: The smartphone shifts from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，而隐私需要本地或混合算力。

carlpei.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage are the challenger's fastest differentiation in mature, homogeneous categories.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：在成熟同质化品类中，设计与高效营销套利是挑战者最快的差异化手段，同时坚持长期让科技有趣。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling 轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the key metric; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（随时间跨度的成功率）是关键指标，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers suffice for AGI, and compute/inference will bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，但算力和推理将在 2028 年成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing fleets of AI agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排和工具更重要，未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience, not just more tokens, fixes hallucination and supplies infinite data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身放在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必经之路上：真正落地的经验而非更多词元，才能修正幻觉并提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning only handles low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将大语言模型比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件——而强化学习只负责低层控制。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅的端到端方案，比学术界常见的复杂模块化路线更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: By 2026 the bottleneck shifts to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so simulation and world models generate synthetic data at scale.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈转向数据：真实机器人数据稀缺，因此靠仿真与世界模型大规模生成合成数据。

jimfan.en: Deepened focus: system two reasoning is progressing, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the robotics GPT-3 moment is ~5 years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年进一步深化：系统二推理进展顺利，但系统一低层控制仍最难；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns to ship fast, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式以求速度，并按 ROI 决定哪些界面值得做到极致，而非面面俱到。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers with ownership and clear decisions so products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是极致速度：给设计师所有权与清晰决策权，让产品更强却不显得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Design is now a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just ship faster.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计从执行提速工具深化为战略武器，强调创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把品牌叙事视为招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此应尽早投资品牌以吸引顶尖人才。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can compete.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否带来常识，认为配合更优推理算法的小模型也能竞争。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; language remains the best medium for reasoning and common sense.
yejin.zh: 同年她指出下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位，但语言仍是承载推理与常识的最佳媒介，这一判断此后一直延续。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate rather than transcend human knowledge, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把问题收敛到数据这一根本瓶颈：现有方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，AI 需要探索未知知识，强化学习需精心工程才能胜过监督微调。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are vital to compete with closed frontier labs; Chinese firms now lead open-source contributions.
yejin.zh: 她同期更强调开放研究与跨机构合作是对抗封闭前沿模型的必要路径，并观察到中国企业在开源贡献上已领先、人才回流。

yejin.en: Small models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 到 2026 年，她主张用高质量多样合成数据与多元对齐让小模型比肩前沿模型，并深化为把强化学习作为预训练目标以换取持久推理提升，同时指出前沿模型存在同质化。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI merges design and engineering, making generalists who own end-to-end execution most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 融合设计与工程，能端到端执行的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner, jam openly without rigid structure; using AI in core workflows is now expected, like the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放协作而不拘泥结构；在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是常态，如同早期互联网。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt, and maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如债务般波动；需与技术债一起迭代偿还，并通过快速、粗糙的实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; generalists with high slope and intrinsic drive beat specialists.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型设计师与工程师团队优于跨职能小组；高斜率、内驱的通才胜过专才。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s design tools are legacy, and AI enables genuine forward progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，以代码为真相源；90 年代的设计工具已过时，AI 带来真正的进步。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出推理阶段的算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Custom models went from a surprise necessity to a core product bet, driven by speed, cost, and every magic moment in Cursor.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从“没料到要做”变成核心产品赌注：速度、成本，以及 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化为：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; incumbents may struggle, and senior engineers often underrate AI.
truell.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开；在位者可能难以适应，资深工程师常低估 AI，而初级工程师又过度依赖。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds funding.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究探索不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight and interpretability, with automated alignment research bootstrapping progress.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督和可解释性，自动化对齐研究能助推进展。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored, so post-training alone can't align AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损，超级对齐团队解散且算力承诺未兑现，仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能）。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulatory oversight like SB 1047 are necessary; non-disparagement clauses hinder whistleblowing.
leike.zh: 2024 年：需要第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管；禁止贬损条款阻碍举报。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than thought because evaluation is easier than generation; worst-case behavior may worsen.
leike.zh: 始终：对齐可实证测试，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成容易；但最坏情况行为可能恶化。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes them smarter, though what happens inside remains alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型视为以「下一个词预测」为核心的 AI-complete 问题，认为靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）就能变强，同时坦言网络内部机制仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution and product managers slow launches.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终相信对话是杀手级应用、最佳用途往往出乎创造者预料，并批评大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑、以及不懂技术通用性的产品经理拖慢落地。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and much longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; sparse mixture-of-experts enables efficient scaling and continual learning.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年初，他把重心转向推理侧算力扩张与超长上下文窗口，主张用稀疏混合专家实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张），并以模块化持续学习替代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; RL and agentic capabilities are crucial, and AI-driven productivity could lift world GDP by orders of magnitude.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他深化为：模型应通过在世界中行动来学习而非被动观察，强化学习与智能体式能力至关重要，AI 带来的生产力提升可能让全球 GDP 增长数个数量级。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped and coding is underhyped; test-time compute alone won't reach AGI, and open-source is closing the gap with frontier models.
shazeer.zh: 最近他进一步强调 AGI（通用人工智能）与编程被低估，认为仅靠测试时算力扩张无法抵达 AGI，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，而 ARC 基准被高估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, while self-play and imitation learning offer strong learning signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长程信用分配，而当时的强化学习缺乏这一能力；同时自博弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Fine-tuning large pre-trained models via transfer learning is a major success; pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers beyond language.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终认为通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是重大成功；到 2021 年进一步指出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation and augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张先验知识应用于数据生成与增强，而非硬编码进神经网络；无监督学习结合强化学习能大幅提升样本效率。

abbeel.en: Real-world value demands 99.9% reliability; a single network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, while curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended settings.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调创造真实价值需要 99.9% 的可靠性；单个网络可泛化到不同仓储任务与末端执行器，而好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。
